# Editions, Studio, Gaming and download pages — evidence

Browser screenshots of the website taken with Playwright (Chromium) against
the local Astro dev server of this branch. They are not desktop captures;
the only desktop image on these pages is the pre-Signal btop/yazi capture,
labelled on the page.

- `editions-night-1280.png`, `editions-night-768.png`,
  `editions-day-360.png`, `editions-night-full-1280.jpg` — `/editions`.
- `studio-night-1280.png`, `gaming-night-1280.png` — edition heroes with
  taglines and maturity meters.
- `download-night-1280.png` — `/install` as the download page.
